walkthroughs.body_html:
Memory — a core area of GCSE Psychology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Memory brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Memory.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

2 minutes

mcqs.q: What is the behaviourist view on the nature-nurture debate?

Strongly nature - behaviours are innate.
Anger, sadness, and guilt.

mcqs.q: What are the three elements of Beck's negative triad?

Negative views of self, world, and future.
Anger, sadness, and guilt.

Just grabbing whoever is around (any haphazard method).
Picking participants who match the population profile.
Every member of the target population has an equal chance of selection.
